newsitem.title: USA: Bridgford Foods Q4 net fell eight pct.
newsitem.headline: Bridgford Foods Q4 net fell eight pct.

text.p: Bridgford Foods Corp said record sales of $118,316,000 for the fiscal year ended November 1, 1996.

Sales rose five percent over record set in the 1995 fiscal year that consisted of 53 weeks. Net income for the 1996 fiscal year totaled $5,651,000, a decrease of 14 percent from the 53 week fiscal year in 1995.
Operating margins were adversely impacted by unusually high grain and pork prices that prevailed during the year.

Sales for the fourth quarter were $30,781,000, a two percent decrease from sales in the same quarter of 1995. Net income for the 13 weeks ended November 1, was $1,860,000, a decrease of eight percent from the 14 week quarter last year.
